name: Zane Valente
source:
"Okay, I'll take that hook" 

Zane sent the media into an unproar a few years ago when he suddely gave up his partying ways become a writer. He went from rebel to recluse in a matter of days and no one quite know why. It's been years but the media hasn't stopped sniffing for a story...
